package.name: parol6_control_services
package.description: ROS 2 service wrappers (std_srvs/Trigger) for one-off imperative PAROL6 operations -- home, gripper open/close -- that don't fit ros2_control's continuous read/write loop. Connects a parol6 RobotClient directly to parol6-server, independent of the ros2_control/parol6_bridge path.
